queries: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - benchmark.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE share > benchmark.average_share;
